title: Improve accessibility with full keyboard navigation for the canvas
description: React Flow supports built-in keyboard navigation and accessibility features (aria- defaults, keyboard controls) since v11. Our app already has some ARIA labels on nodes and the canvas, but lacks full keyboard navigation support for power users and accessibility compliance. Improvements: 1) Enable Tab-key navigation between nodes, 2) Add keyboard shortcut to open the side panel for the focused node (Enter/Space already works on nodes but tab focus between them is missing), 3) Add visible focus indicators on edges, 4) Ensure the MiniMap and Controls are keyboard-accessible. Reference: synergycodes.com guide on building usable and accessible diagrams with React Flow.
